extra.reason: Moved session list off the main screen into a new SessionsView pushed via a 'Sessions' NavigationLink. Main screen now only shows live BPM + device + recording (no longer queries the DB). SessionsView owns the ForEach(sessions) list, per-session swipe delete + CSV, Export-All, Delete-All, and the DB-path footer; loads via model.db.sessions() on appear. ShareSheet/alert plumbing moved with it. Pure presentation refactor, no DB/HeartRateManager changes. Verified: xcodebuild iphonesimulator BUILD SUCCEEDED. Version bumped 0.11->0.12, build 6->7.

Reordered ContentView so recordSection (Start/Stop, Elapsed, Samples) sits above deviceSection: liveSection -> recordSection -> deviceSection -> Sessions link. Collapsed the 5-row device section into a DisclosureGroup (collapsed by default) whose label is the 'Strap: <name>' summary (connected name visible at a glance); expanding reveals Sensor, Firmware, Change/Choose Device, Forget Device. Preserved semantics: Change/Choose & Forget stay .disabled(hr.isRecording); Choose vs Change label logic; Forget shown only when connected or preferredDeviceUUID exists; showDevicePicker sheet flow unchanged. Pure presentation, no HeartRateManager/DB changes. Verified: xcodebuild iphonesimulator BUILD SUCCEEDED. Version bumped 0.12->0.13, build 7->8.

Added optional date-gated CSV export. HRDatabase.exportCSV now takes from/to Date? params (default nil = full history, so existing per-session swipe export and Export-All are unchanged); builds the WHERE clause dynamically with s.ts >= from AND s.ts < to bound parameters, leveraging idx_samples_ts. Streaming/chunked 64KB write path and queue.sync split unchanged. A date-filtered range matching zero samples writes no file and returns nil (graceful empty-range). SessionsView gains a 'Limit to date range' toggle revealing From/To .date DatePickers; bounds are whole calendar days (startOfDay..<startOfDay+1d, end-day inclusive); start>end disables the export button with an inline warning. Verified: xcodebuild iphonesimulator BUILD SUCCEEDED. Per corrected release policy: MARKETING_VERSION 0.13->0.14, CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION reset 8->1.
Added centered version footer to ContentView; build bumped to 0.14 (3); Release archive succeeded
